links.outcome: Radiologist-rated quality and laterality accuracy of LLM Arabic translations of BI-RADS reports
links.effect: Overall mean scores: Gemini 3.73, DeepSeek 3.54, ChatGPT 3.03 (p<0.001); ChatGPT scored lower on all eight domains; no laterality errors among 15 translations.
links.quote: No laterality errors were identified among the 15 translations.

screen.reason: Empirical reader study comparing three LLMs on translating breast imaging reports into Arabic for patient communication, evaluated by radiologists across safety and communication domains without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
